description: 976 Réseau de fibre optique du Département de Mayotte is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. Linéaire en fibre optique reliant 7 Sous-Répartiteur (SR) éligibles à l'offre PRM d'Orange. Elle consiste, pour chaque sous-répartiteur (SR) concerné, à implanter une armoire de rue pour accueillir les opérateurs, à proximité immédiate des armoires de sous répartition (SR), et en aval des nœuds de raccordement d’abonnés (NRA). Coverage: FR. The listing shows 2020-01-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
